title: I keep dreaming about mall world....but it feel strange
content: I have been dreaming about Mall World for a while. It’s been odd dream after odd dream where I appear in an old wooden church. The church is white and gray with a red cross on the top. When I walk inside, I see a figure at the altar. As I step closer, I’m suddenly teleported to a mall. I start to walk around. There are people I know and people I don’t know. One time I remember seeing my friend Mason. I tried talking to him, but he didn’t seem to notice me, I guess. After that happened, I woke up. A few months later, I had the same dream—the same church, the same mall—but this time I walked around and found a Halloween store that looked like a Spirit Halloween, except it was way bigger than any Spirit Halloween I have ever seen. I walked inside and started to look at the things they had. I remember picking up a dress and walking to the front, but when I went to pay, I was teleported into an arcade. The arcade was almost empty. Aside from me, there was the cashier and two other people. I started to explore. There were games I had never seen before. I can’t remember the names of them, but some of the machines were huge. I kept exploring the arcade for a while until I stumbled onto a door, which led to a huge aquarium. I walked in, and in the center there was a huge circle of smaller aquariums—the type of aquariums you can buy at a pet shop. There were fish I had never seen before. I remember seeing a black fish that had a red glow to it and a jellyfish that glowed pink. Aside from that, I woke up very suddenly. I have also seen in my dreams poisonous plants attacking humans , I have seen myself in a hospital holding a child when it starts flooding two guys walk in a blond one and a brunette one , they help me out but while we wade through the water the baby goes missing, I think this is connected to mall world some how can someone please explain?
